options.COOPERATE: Synchronize switch timings with the automated interlocking system to ensure uninterrupted corridor passage.
options.INDEPENDENT: Pass through junctions using standard uncoupled signals without coordination or adjustment.
options.COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Preempt freight signals at each junction to delay regional trains and secure express priority.
options.DISENGAGE: Postpone train departures until evening freight traffic has fully cleared the corridor.
